slot_scores.name: product_I_no_production_Q2
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about quarter-specific production restrictions, including whether Product I can be produced in Q2.

slot_scores.name: contract_reservations_must_be_delivered
slot_scores.evidence_quote: The table is labeled "contract reservations" — should each quarter's production be at least the reserved amount (i.e., reservations are minimum delivery requirements that can be exceeded), or exactly equal to the reserved amount (i.e., production/delivery is fixed and cannot exceed the reservation)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether reservations are minimum delivery requirements, which touches demand fulfillment semantics, but did not explicitly ask whether all reservations must eventually be delivered or whether late delivery/backlogging is allowed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Product I can be produced in all quarters, including Q2, unless otherwise restricted.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the hidden constraint that Product I cannot be produced in Q2, and no user message confirmed it.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Contract reservations are minimum delivery requirements that can be exceeded, but the agent did not confirm that all reservations must eventually be fulfilled even if late.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent asked only whether reservations are minimum versus exact, not whether late delivery is allowed and all reservations must be fulfilled.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped after repeated low-value questions without resolving the P1 hidden slots about Product I Q2 production restriction and full contract reservation fulfillment.

summary: The agent asked many clarifying questions but missed the two key hidden constraints: Product I cannot be produced in Q2, and all contract reservations must eventually be delivered with late delivery allowed. It also repeated several questions unnecessarily, indicating poor stopping behavior.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
